display_name: Impulse Efficiency S1 (H1 Z_t/ER_t | SL 0.75% / TP 0.50%)

logic.summary: H1 directional impulse continuation gate (|Z_t(3)| >= 2.0 vs pre-move 20-bar RMS volatility, ER_t(3) >= 0.75) with quick-harvest SL 0.75% / TP 0.50% of entry price.
logic.economic_rationale: Captures short-horizon continuation after forced directional order flow (stop cascades / split institutional orders) while filtering choppy whipsaws via Efficiency Ratio.
known_assumptions: Pre-move volatility uses bars [k .. k+W] strictly before the impulse window to prevent self-scaling lookahead.
Requires independent Out-of-Sample verification once raw MT5 optimization XML is uploaded to Drive Vault.
rejection_criteria: Conditional forward return after spread and slippage <= 0 (indicating exhaustion rather than continuation).
Parameter stability fails when Z_t or ER_t thresholds shift by +/-10%.
